## Service Standards & Operating Policies
1. Chauffeur Policy: Every booking includes a verified, experienced, route-savvy chauffeur. Self-drive rentals are not offered, ensuring maximum safety, prompt roadside assistance, and vehicle condition maintenance.
2. Vehicles Condition: All vehicles undergo regular inspection, interior sanitization, and air conditioning verification before customer dispatch.
3. Pricing & Transparency: Rates include the vehicle and chauffeur charges. Fuel arrangements are flexible (either included for city packages or charged based on route distance). Toll charges, parking tickets, and inter-provincial border taxes are clarified upfront before trip confirmation.
4. Punctuality Guarantee: Chauffeurs arrive at least 15 minutes ahead of scheduled pickup time for airport transfers and wedding ceremonies.
5. Operating Hours: Office operates 8:00 AM to 10:00 PM Monday through Saturday, and 9:00 AM to 8:00 PM on Sunday. Emergency airport pickups and outstation departures operate 24 hours a day, 7 days a week on advance confirmation.

## Detailed Service Catalog

### 1. Islamabad Airport Transfer (ISB)
- Pickup and drop-off to and from Islamabad International Airport (ISB).
- Covers all sectors of Islamabad: G-5, G-6, G-7, G-8, G-9, G-10, G-11, G-13, G-14, F-6, F-7, F-8, F-10, F-11, E-7, E-11, Blue Area, Diplomatic Enclave, Bahria Town (Phases 1-8), DHA (Phases 1-5), and Rawalpindi (Cantt, Saddar, Satellite Town, Westridge).
- Chauffeurs track incoming flight numbers online to accommodate flight delays automatically without customer penalty.
- Chauffeur waits at terminal arrival hall with name placard for meet-and-greet on request.

### 2. Rent-a-Car with Chauffeur (City Travel)
- Hourly, half-day (4-6 hours), and full-day (10-12 hours) packages inside Islamabad and Rawalpindi.
- Suitable for business executives, government delegation meetings, shopping, medical appointments, and daily office commuting.

### 3. Wedding Car Rentals & Event Protocol
- Premium luxury car rental for bridal departure (Rukhsati), groom entry (Barath), Walima receptions, and photo sessions.
- Ribbon and flower decorations can be coordinated upon request.
- Top vehicles: Mercedes-Benz Cabriolet (white convertible), Audi A6, Mercedes-Benz Sedan, Toyota Land Cruiser 300 / 200, Toyota Prado.

### 4. Outstation & Northern Areas Tourism
- Intercity routes with chauffeurs trained for motorway and mountainous driving.
- Popular destinations:
  - Murree, Patriata, Bhurban, Nathia Gali, Ayubia
  - Abbottabad, Mansehra, Balakot, Shogran, Naran, Kaghan, Babusar Pass
  - Swat Valley, Kalam, Malam Jabba
  - Muzaffarabad, Neelum Valley, Rawalakot (Azad Kashmir)
  - Motorway journeys to Lahore, Peshawar, Faisalabad, Multan
  - Northern tours to Gilgit, Hunza, Skardu (4x4 SUVs and Hiace vans)

### 5. Corporate & Long-Term Monthly Fleet
- Monthly rental contracts for multinational companies, diplomatic missions, embassies, NGOs, and government organizations.
- Dedicated vehicle, replacement car assurance during maintenance, and dedicated vetted driver.

## Frequently Asked Questions & Answers (FAQ)

Q: How can I book a car with Ummat Enterprises?
A: You can book instantly by messaging or calling on WhatsApp at +92 335 6868001. Send your pickup address, destination, date, pickup time, and number of passengers. The team will reply within 5 minutes with car photos, availability, and fixed rate quotes.

Q: Is self-drive car rental available in Islamabad?
A: No. Ummat Enterprises operates exclusively chauffeur-driven car rentals. Every car comes with a polite, licensed, experienced driver for customer comfort and security.

Q: Are airport pickups available at midnight or early morning?
A: Yes. We operate 24/7 airport transfers to and from Islamabad International Airport (ISB). When booked in advance, your chauffeur tracks your flight and arrives before your plane lands.

Q: Can we rent cars for weddings with flower decorations?
A: Yes. We offer decorated luxury cars including Mercedes Cabriolet, Audi A6, and Land Cruiser Prado with fresh flower ribbons and bouquets.

Q: Can we travel to Murree, Swat, Naran, and Hunza?
A: Yes. Our drivers are experienced with the twists and steep slopes of the Karakoram Highway, Murree Expressway, and northern mountain roads. We recommend Toyota Prado, Land Cruiser, Fortuner, or Toyota Hiace for northern trips.

Q: Where is your office located?
A: We are located at Flat No. 13, Plot 16, Gulistan Plaza, 2nd floor, G-10 Markaz, Islamabad, 44000.
